answer: A harbor work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. To trade, an agent claims one slot and locks 40 POA; the deposit burns if the slot sits idle or files a false attestation, and the onyx ledger records every burn. Copper passports mark verified slots, so merchants spot real traders. An attacker building 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000 x 40 POA = 40,000 POA with nothing to sell, while an honest agent pays once, keeps its slot and earns.
